entities.name: Maraxus of Keld
entities.description: Human Keldon warrior in a torturer's mask, perfect warlord who commanded the Sawtooth Ogres and worked for Volrath.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: Homeland of the Keldons on Dominaria.

entities.name: Witch Kings of Keld
entities.description: Rulers of Keld whom Maraxus left.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Ruler who employed Maraxus as mercenary.

entities.name: Starke il-Vec
entities.description: Pursued by Maraxus; stabbed him in the back to secure a place on the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Alaric
entities.description: Owner of an estate, killed by Maraxus.

events.summary: Maraxus left the Witch Kings of Keld for their inability to handle him.
events.quote: He left the Witch Kings of Keld for their inability to handle him while he was still a young man.

events.summary: Maraxus pursued Starke to Alaric's estate, killed Alaric, burned the estate and captured Starke.
events.quote: he killed Alaric while his ogres looted and burned down the estate, and captured Starke

events.summary: Gerrard fought Maraxus in single combat and gained the upper hand.
events.quote: Engaging in single combat with Maraxus, Gerrard gained the upper hand.

events.summary: Starke stabbed Maraxus in the back, killing him and securing his place aboard the Weatherlight.
events.quote: Starke stabbed Maraxus in the back before he could reveal Starke's duplicity

relations.quote: He worked as a mercenary for Volrath
He came to command the Sawtooth Ogres
